Staff Vacancy
Saturday, 26 June 2021
7686 Hits
Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram invites applications for the following post. The application on plain paper along with the attested copies of educational qualification and experience must reach to the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha  442102 before
15
th
July, 2021
.
Post
Qualification & Experience
X-Ray Technician-1   (Category -  ST)                             B.Sc. with Diploma in Radiodiagnosis with minimum 3 years of experience in a hospital with 500 beds or more.
Dental Hygienist- 1 (Category - Open )                           Diploma in Dental Hygienist course registered with Central Council of India and Dental Council of India (DCI) with                                                                                           three year of experience working in a large hospital/Medical College/Dental College.
Note :-
Upper age limit 38 years for open category and 43 years for reserved category. Age and experience can be relaxed for exceptional and deserving candidate. Decision of the Selection Committee will be final.
Those who had applied in reference to our earlier advertisement need not to apply again.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
paragraphs: Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram invites applications for the following post. The application on plain paper along with the attested copies of educational qualification and experience must reach to the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 before 15 th July, 2021.
X-Ray Technician-1 (Category - ST) B.Sc. with Diploma in Radiodiagnosis with minimum 3 years of experience in a hospital with 500 beds or more.

Dental Hygienist- 1 (Category - Open) Diploma in Dental Hygienist course registered with Central Council of India and Dental Council of India (DCI) with three year of experience working in a large hospital/Medical College/Dental College.

Note:- Upper age limit 38 years for open category and 43 years for reserved category. Age and experience can be relaxed for exceptional and deserving candidate. Decision of the Selection Committee will be final.
Those who had applied in reference to our earlier advertisement need not to apply again.
